title: Ya moosa-e-kazim
body:
Ya moosa-e-kazim
Abu ar-reza
(Yabna jaffar, abur-raza) x2 (Abur-raza) x2
(Ya musa-e-kazim) x2
<<MINI>>
Tu saathwa mushkil khusha, noor-e-janaab-e-sayyeda
<<DIVIDER>>
(Ya musa-e-kazim) x4
1. Tere baba imam-e-sadiq hai
Jiske dam se hai Jafferi saare
Deen-o-mazhab, sabak ibaadat hai
Ham ko saaye usi ke dar se mile
<<MINI>>
Tu saathwa mushkil khusha, noor-e-janaab-e-sayyeda (Ya musa-e-kazim) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hai qaramat-e-murtaza tujhme
Saailo(n) ke bhi ye ata tujhme
Rad jo hoti nahi kisi surat
Saans leti hai wo dua tujhme
<<MINI>>
Tu saathwa mushkil khusha, noor-e-janaab-e-sayyeda (Ya musa-e-kazim) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tum bhi hajat rawa-e-alam ho
Haideriyyat ka azm-e-mauqam ho
Tum dua-e-janab-e-zahra se
Pursadar-e-janab-e-adam ho
<<MINI>>
Tu saathwa mushkil khusha, noor-e-janaab-e-sayyeda (Ya musa-e-kazim) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bas junoon-o-jabal jilawatni
Tere pyaaro(n) ke tujhse hai paayi
Kitne dana the tere diwane
Umr bhar teri nokri karli
<<MINI>>
Tu saathwa mushkil khusha, noor-e-janaab-e-sayyeda (Ya musa-e-kazim) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Almadad (maula raza) x3
5. Tera beta imam-e-zamin hai
Jiske qabze mei raat hai din hai
Wo khurasaan ka hai shehzada
Har shifa uske dar pe mumkin hai
<<MINI>>
Tu saathwa mushkil khusha, noor-e-janaab-e-sayyeda (Ya musa-e-kazim) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Teri dukhtar hai qum ki shehzaadi
Uski chowkat pe de sada jo bhi
Joliyaa(n) apni bhar ke laata hai
Ghamse milti hai usko aazaadi
<<MINI>>
Tu saathwa mushkil khusha, noor-e-janaab-e-sayyeda (Ya musa-e-kazim) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Tere taboot ki wo tanhaayi
Na tha beta ghareeb na bhaayi
Chand mazboor aye ujrat par
Lash raste se teri uthwaayi
<<MINI>>
Tu saathwa mushkil khusha, noor-e-janaab-e-sayyeda (Ya musa-e-kazim) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Hai najaf dushmano(n) ke narghe mei
Karbala samara ke raste mei
Bekafan momino(n) ke laashe hai
Kufr dakhil huwa madine mei
<<MINI>>
Tu saathwa mushkil khusha, noor-e-janaab-e-sayyeda (Ya musa-e-kazim) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Maula tu bhi dar-e-hawaaij hai
Tera sikka jahaa(n) waaij hai
Ham to har imtihaa(n) se guzrenge
Dene wala tuhi nataij hai
<<MINI>>
Tu saathwa mushkil khusha, noor-e-janaab-e-sayyeda (Ya musa-e-kazim) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Tu bhi Rehan istighasa kar
Kehke ya Musa ya bin-e-jafar
Nauha goyi karu qayamat tak Aur ghulaami karu dar-e-shah par
<<MINI>>
Tu saathwa mushkil khusha, noor-e-janaab-e-sayyeda (Ya musa-e-kazim) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Yabn-e-jaffar abur-raza) x2 Abur-raza
